rationale: Independent quaternion/TRS calculation matches every old Mustang baked wheel/body position at emitted float32 precision; direct editable loader preserves source node TRS and applies only a common floor/center translation. Relative wheel placement error originates before these stages.

Native parser maps wheels.maxSuspension to wheel-record offset0x18; numWheels allocates zero-cleared count*0x58 records; preview initialization multiplies that field by independently checked binary constant0.5 into state offset0x47c; both native render spans subtract it from Y before world transform.

Correction applies the half-travel Y subtraction to wheel and brake centers, preserves X/Z, dimensions, rotation, texture selector, and defaults missing travel to zero. Finite/nonnegative travel is a project safeguard, not asserted native validation.
Actual Mustang readonly corrected build yields all wheel Y centers0.25, 1576 triangles, no warnings; after floor translation body clearance changes from0.0413175 to0.1413175.

Corrected Blender image check forces packed image load via dimensions and pixel access. Independently, all seven actual Mustang packed images changed has_data=false to true and have positive decoded dimensions/pixel counts.
All eight assembly tests pass on current and system Python; Ruff passes on all three reviewed files.
limitations: This approves the pinned code and native static preview interpretation, not game physics equilibrium or dynamic suspension.
No lateral wheel adjustment is supported by the supplied evidence; configured native X coordinates and dimensions remain unchanged.
Actual regenerated outputs, editable safe upgrade, freshness checks, corrected browser appearance and final full suite require root final evidence.
Before-fix coordinate/viewer receipts intentionally pin the previous published Mustang GLB; corrected native probe is in-memory only.
Blender image probe validates lazy decoding but does not establish original shader fidelity; full corrected roundtrip root log is separately retained.

results.claim: In the pinned Redline i386 preview routine, each wheel runtime travel at +0x47c is initialized to 0.5 times configured wheels.maxSuspension (config +0x18); both simple and detailed wheel draw paths subtract this travel from configured wheels.pos.y. A static model matching this native preview therefore uses center [pos.x, pos.y - 0.5*maxSuspension, pos.z]. This is preview pose, not a claim about runtime physics equilibrium.

For an omitted wheels.maxSuspension, the native config loader zero-initializes the numWheels * 0x58 allocation with _NewPtrClear; its maxSuspension handler writes wheel +0x18 through sscanf only on the matching field. In this configuration-loading branch the missing-field fallback is therefore 0.0. Finite/nonnegative conversion checks are separate safeguards and are not native loader validation.
